usedFor: AITable.ai holds form answers and records, and HubSpot gets a deal from each “New Form” through “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Form” in AITable.ai, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A submitted form carries the answers, and the action turns them into a deal.

watchOut: “Update Deal” in HubSpot needs the deal ID, so have the ID ready before you map it from AITable.ai.
